ideas.title: Investigation into Kash Patel's Alleged Slush Fund
ideas.description: An investigation into Kash Patel's alleged use of taxpayer dollars to pay loyalist agents.
ideas.angle: The potential misuse of taxpayer dollars and the implications for national security.
questions: What is the extent of Kash Patel's alleged slush fund?
How did he use taxpayer dollars?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a significant abuse of power and taxpayer dollars, and could have major implications for national security and government accountability.

ideas.title: Analysis of Minnesota Immigration Crackdown
ideas.description: An analysis of the federal prosecutors' charges against 15 people for impeding agents during the Minnesota immigration crackdown.
ideas.angle: The implications of the charges and the effectiveness of the immigration crackdown.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the charges?
How effective was the immigration crackdown?
ideas.insight: This story could provide insight into the impact of the immigration crackdown on public safety and community relations.
